title: Shivanaga
desc: Shiva and his wife, Nagamma, are held captive by his evil uncles who want to acquire his wealth. Soon, two snakes assume the form of Shiva and Nagamma to save them from their abusive family.

title: Adrushta Rekhe
desc: Sunderaja, an educated but unemployed individual, and Shamala, a rich palace girl who is unhappy, both decide to end their lives. However, a twist of fate offers them a second chance at life.

title: Dance Raja Dance
desc: Raja, a dancer, vows to take revenge on a rich man for killing his father. He falls in love with Radha, but little does he know that she is the daughter of the man who killed his father.

title: Sarvasva
desc: When two friends set off to make their celluloid dream into a reality, they encounter various obstacles and a visually impaired woman who changes their lives forever.

title: Tunturu
desc: A college student and her friends cross paths with a dangerous gang of criminals when one of them witnesses a murder.
